profile.headline: Optimization Engineer at Tapestry
profile.summary: As a mechanical engineer with an interest and background in energy, I recognize the need to use resources optimally to reduce cost and ensure a sustainable future. I would like to work for a firm that shares my interest and promotes solutions that are not only cost-effective but are also socially responsible. I am interested in making an impact locally, as well as globally, and would like to work on problems and develop tools that can be applied internationally.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Optimization
positions.description: Developing and deploying Tapestry's optimization software across the Grid Planning Tool and GridOps tool.

positions.title: Staff Research Engineer
positions.description: Work as the tech lead for the NEM (Australian Electric market) product team. I help architect, develop, deploy, and maintain the core optimization and bidding strategies/software related to our Mosiac application. The application is used by large battery and renewable asset owners to optimal bid their assets into NEM market in an automated manner.
positions.insights: Skills: Electricity Markets · Python (Programming Language) · Optimization · Kubernetes · Kotlin

positions.title: Lead Analyst
positions.description: Technical analyst serving as liaison between core model development team and Business Development team. Working with the model development team to improve and validate solutions for battery and other distributed energy resources. Working with the Business Development team to analyze potential customer sites and optimize unique solutions for those sites.

positions.title: Project Engineer
positions.description: I am part of the Energy Modeling team within the Analysis Group at Integral Group. We provide energy modeling services for both our internal design team as well as external clients. We specialize in both standard modeling techniques as well as the novel techniques required for deep green buildings. I perform modeling and analysis from the conceptual phase to LEED submission to energy efficient retrofit measures.

positions.title: Energy Analysis Engineer
positions.description: Work on a capacity expansion model of the national electric sector -- ReEDS.

positions.title: Mickey Leland Fellow
positions.description: Worked on a thermodynamic equilibrium model of the trace contaminants in coal syngas.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Worked as a commissioning agent and general engineering consultant.

positions.title: Technical Intern
positions.description: Worked as part of the Water and Wastewater treatment group assisting in the design of water and wastewater treatment facilities.

positions.title: Technical Intern
positions.description: Work as part of the Wastewater Treatment design team.

publications.title: Integrated Canada-U.S. Power Sector Modeling with the Regional Energy Deployment System (ReEDS)
